summary: Add a repository-default proprietary, all-rights-reserved LICENSE and clarify that existing Apache-2.0 crate metadata is scoped package/dependency policy, not a repository-wide open-source grant.
claim_boundary: This change adds a root proprietary license posture and documentation boundaries only. It does not provide attorney review, relicense third-party materials, sweep every package manifest, change dependency allow-lists, publish packages, or mutate branch protection/CI settings.

source_basis.use: GitHub documentation basis for treating explicit repository licensing as important and distinguishing public repository visibility from license grants.
SPDX reference basis for using a custom LicenseRef identifier rather than falsely claiming a standard OSI license.

facets.F1_simplicity: One root LICENSE is the default authority, with only two narrow documentation clarifications to prevent package metadata confusion.
facets.F2_hyperscaler: The posture protects first-party platform IP while preserving explicit third-party/component notices required for commercial software supply chains.
facets.F3_adversarial: The license text explicitly rejects implied grants from hosting settings, package metadata, informal communications, and public visibility.
facets.F4_api_contract: No runtime API, package manifest, crate dependency, or service contract changed.
facets.F5_quality: The edit is deterministic text/docs only and was checked for required markers plus whitespace validity.
facets.F6_operations: Operators and agents now have a root-level license file and README pointer for repository-default IP handling.
facets.F7_security_privacy: The text reserves rights around confidential materials, trade secrets, access-control notices, security findings, and unauthorized extraction.
facets.F8_supply_chain: Third-party and explicit component notices remain scoped exceptions; the change does not relicense dependencies or remove SBOM/dependency-license policy.
facets.F9_testing: Validation covered root license existence, SPDX LicenseRef marker, all-rights-reserved marker, README pointer, governance lane boundary, ADR-0013 boundary, diff hygiene, and Buck2 license-policy library builds.
facets.F10_ci_cd: No CI workflow or branch protection settings changed for this license-only slice.
facets.F11_observability: No live service or telemetry behavior changed.
facets.F13_reversibility: The change is isolated to one new root file and three docs references; rollback is a single commit revert.

verification.command: python3 inline marker check for LICENSE, README, governance lane, and ADR-0013 boundaries
